analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive days. RSI has slightly rebounded after entering oversold territory but recovery above 50 is insufficient. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in negative territory. Volume ratio at 0.81 for 5 consecutive days indicates lack of buying pressure. ADX at 20-day is 28.0, indicating early trend formation, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting continued downward pressure.
